summary: A ~12 m cruising sailing catamaran: twin lofted fine-entry hulls with navy boot stripes and black toe rails… joints boom, rudder_l, rudder_r; sockets waterline, helm, eye_point, trampoline.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.catamaran or place "prefab": "catamaran" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d().
